title: Yet Another Product With Bad Adhesive Residue Left Behind From Their Label
text:
Yet Another Product With Bad Adhesive Residue Left Behind From Their Label. As everyone knows, One Star on Amazon equates to the feeling of "I Hate It."

They put a sticker on the long metal vertical front "wire rod" that is so difficult to remove, and that left two inches of terrible crap and sticky residue behind! (And I hate it!) There is no reason whatsoever this has to occur in 2016! They make adhesive that leaves behind no residue. For $50+ for this item, this company can afford labels that leave behind no residue. But let's say they do not wanna spend the extra money for the residue-free adhesive for their stickers. They could put a tag on it that is attached to string or plastic tie you simply cut off.

(And I bet when they ship this during a heatwave, it can make the adhesive issue even worse.)

Yes, I know full well I can buy that goof-off stuff to assist in trying to remove the crud. But I just spent enough money buying the rack. Why do I have to spend more money buying a crud remover, and then have to spend time scraping and rubbing?

Regarding the rack: I am disappointed the left and right sections, which swing in and out, have no locking mechanism to keep the arms open in one spot without them moving at the slightest touch, for folks who might not wanna screw down the base into a countertop (especially people at home who might wanna use this product).

Poorly designed, in my opinion.

I only recommend this item for folks who will screw it down into a counter, and who do not mind having to spend time and effort scraping off two inches of adhesive residue.

Also, this item is overpriced, in my opinion.
